ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the parabola \(y_{1}=ax^{2}+bx+c\) intersects the line \(y_{2}=mx+n\) at points \((3,0)\) and \((0,3)\). If \(ax^{2}+bx+c>mx+n\), what is the range of values for \(x\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} According to the graph of the functions, \\
when $x<0$ or $x>3$, $y_1>y_2$, \\
thus the solution set for $ax^2+bx+c>mx+n$ is $x<0$ or $x>3$. \\
Therefore, the answer is: $\boxed{x<0$ or $x>3}$.
